meta.title: BMW 3 Series Engine Rebuild & Repair | Boby Engine Work
meta.description: BMW 3 Series engine rebuilding, reconditioning and repair at Boby Engine Work. E36, E46, E90, F30 and G20/G21 assessed individually with written scope before work begins.

paragraphs: Whether your 320d has stopped after a timing fault or your petrol 3 Series is losing compression, the first decision is the same: establish what has failed before choosing a repair.

Boby and the team at Boby Engine Work provide BMW 3 Series engine rebuilding, reconditioning and mechanical repairs. We assess E36, E46, E90, F30 and G20/G21 models, with the engine and installation checked individually.

image.alt: BMW 3 Series with the bonnet open in Boby's workshop

paragraphs: A 320d badge does not identify the engine. Depending on year and market, the same badge can sit above different diesel four-cylinders — and petrol badges are no clearer.

Generation and body style are the useful first filter. Once we know whether you have an E46, E90, F30 or G20 — and what symptoms you are seeing — we can identify the likely engine family and quote to what is actually fitted.

generations.title: Older Petrol and Diesel 3 Series
generations.text: The 1990s and early-2000s 3 Series range covers saloon, Touring, coupé, convertible and Compact body styles. Engine identity still has to be confirmed — badges and markets do not map one-to-one.

generations.title: Saloon, Touring, Coupé and Convertible
generations.text: Mid-2000s to early-2010s 3 Series cars span naturally aspirated and turbo petrols plus common-rail diesels. Special versions such as the 320si and E9x M3 need their own engine confirmation before quoting.

generations.title: Later Diesels, Turbo Petrols and Hybrids
generations.text: The 2010s F-generation family includes saloon, Touring and Gran Turismo applications, with turbo petrols, later diesels, ActiveHybrid 3 and 330e plug-in hybrid systems depending on year.

generations.title: Later 3 Series Engine Repairs
generations.text: Current 320i/330i, 318d/320d/330d and M340i/M340d applications sit in this generation, including mild-hybrid and PHEV systems where fitted. Exact derivative and hybrid layout still need confirming.

section3.note: This is an enquiry guide to principal engine families, not a guarantee that every engine appeared in every UK badge. Exact codes, year and installation still need confirming before a written rebuild scope is issued.

notes.title: Important information
notes.text: Guide figures cover labour, standard fluids, consumables and VAT where stated. Turbochargers, injectors and other ancillaries are excluded unless itemised in the written quote.

notes.title: If further work is needed
notes.text: If strip-down shows an unserviceable block or crankshaft, or damage beyond the agreed scope, we stop, explain the findings and revise the quotation before continuing.

cta.label: Request a Quote
cta.hint: Send registration, mileage, symptoms, where the car is and whether it runs.

paragraphs: External leaks or injector problems can stay smaller repairs. A cracked block or a contaminated crankshaft changes the scope. The quotation identifies the work that applies to your engine — not a generic package.
Mention any previous engine replacement, tuning, overheating, or low-oil-pressure warnings when you enquire so we can assess the right route first.

section5.intro: Symptoms point to a fault family. The engine code, generation and inspection decide whether the job is a limited repair or a full rebuild.

image.alt: BMW 3 Series front grille and headlight

cards.title: N47 or Other Timing-System Failure
cards.text: Rattle on cold start, timing-chain noise or a diesel that has jumped timing. We confirm which chain layout is fitted and whether damage stayed contained or reached the valves and pistons.

aside.label: Our Approach
aside.text: Identify the chain route first. Limited repair only if inspection shows contained damage.

cards.title: Oil Pressure, Knock or Bearing Wear
cards.text: Low oil-pressure warnings, deep knock or metal in the sump point to lubrication and bearing damage. Stop the engine and tell us when the warning first appeared.

aside.label: Key Point
aside.text: Continued running after a pressure warning often turns a repair into a full rebuild.

cards.title: Overheating, Smoke or Compression Loss
cards.text: Overheat events, white or blue smoke, misfire and low compression need a staged check of cooling, head integrity and cylinder condition before major work is authorised.

aside.label: Important Note
aside.text: We separate cooling and head issues from internal wear before quoting rebuild scope.

cta.heading: Need a Diagnostic Assessment for Your 3 Series?
cta.text: Send registration, mileage, symptoms and where the car is. Add a short recording of the noise if helpful.
